rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
fused form of siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ and mūlakaulam with internal sandhi

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula teaching addressed to the fair-faced goddess?
premises: The verse enumerates eight as a key quantity.
Attainment of powers is identified with the root Kaula.
The teaching is directly addressed to the fair-faced goddess.
items.inference: The root Kaula consists in the attainment of the eight powers.
uncertainties: The specific eight powers are not named in this verse and rely on context.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
